CIOs report reallocating spend across major enterprise platforms to align with AI readiness and operational leverage.

The reallocation of platform spend is closely tied to broader architectural shifts.

CIOs are narrowing platform stacks to reduce complexity, improve governance, and accelerate AI deployment at scale.

AI, security, cloud, and modernization are now inseparable decisions.”

Enterprise CIOs are no longer funding AI as a series of isolated pilots.
